units.source_text: 通过这一事件，我一举直面所有的一切，直面人生、官能、叛逆、憎恨、爱情和一切。

en.t: Through this event, I suddenly came face to face with everything: life, sensuality, rebellion, hatred, love, and all the rest.

units.source_text: 这样，我的记忆乐于否定和无视其中所蕴含着的崇高的因素。

en.t: In this way, my memory was glad to deny and ignore the noble elements contained within it.
